triggers.metric: Grades failing correlation-adjusted (Vasicek rho=0.03) test at 5% (of 8)

reference_tests.metric: REFERENCE (not used for the status): grades failing plain binomial test at 5% (of 8)
reference_tests.note: Assumes independent defaults; over-rejects when a whole vintage shares one economy.

reference_tests.metric: REFERENCE: grades failing Jeffreys test at 5% (of 8)

calibration_basis: correlation-adjusted (Vasicek single-factor, rho = 0.03; sensitivity 0.01-0.04 in calibration_rho_sensitivity.csv). The plain binomial count is a reference only.
redevelopment_policy: Recalibrate on a fresh validation window when any metric is AMBER; redevelop and revalidate when any is RED or two are AMBER for two consecutive quarters. Review quarterly; full revalidation at least annually.
review_frequency: monthly PSI/CSI, quarterly performance, annual validation
